proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: We drive down from Ben Lomond once a month. I pre-order on the way past Felton and it's bagged by the time we park. Same friendly person most Saturdays, too.
reviews.name: Leah D.

reviews.text: Went in on a foggy Tuesday morning because the site said it's quiet then, and it was. Had the whole counter to myself and asked every beginner question I had.
reviews.name: Roberta C.

reviews.text: My sister was visiting from Texas and nervous about the whole thing. The budtender started her with the smallest chocolate square, wrote the timing down, and never made her feel silly.
reviews.name: Marisa J.

reviews.text: Local, calm, and the jars are opened right in front of you. I've been a regular for years; prices are posted and they don't change at the register.
reviews.name: Daniel O.

reviews.text: Rain on Highway 17, so I did curbside. Texted my name, held my license up, done. Under five minutes door to door from the lot.
reviews.name: Kenji H.

reviews.text: Good little shop. They asked what I'd used before instead of pushing the priciest cartridge, and the one they suggested was half the price.
reviews.name: Alana R.

proof.guarantee: If your pre-order is wrong at pickup, we fix it at the counter before you pay.
